title: Homepage shows main header or banner
description: The homepage loads and displays the main header or promotional banner.

title: Catalog lists products
description: The product catalog page lists at least 10 products and shows product names and prices.
kane_one_liner: Catalog page lists products with names and prices
kane_summary: Verify product list and prices are visible

title: Product detail shows name and Add to Cart
description: A product detail page shows product name, price, and an Add to Cart button.
kane_one_liner: Product detail shows name, price, and Add to Cart
kane_summary: Verify product detail elements are visible

title: Add product to cart updates cart
description: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart item count and displays the item in the cart.
kane_one_liner: Add product to cart updates cart indicator
kane_summary: Verify cart count and cart contents after add

title: Cart allows update and remove
description: The cart page allows updating quantity and removing items; totals update accordingly.
kane_one_liner: Cart update and remove work and recalc totals

description: User can add a product to the cart from the product detail page and see the cart item count update
User can open the cart dropdown and see the list of added items with their names and prices
User can navigate to the Laptops product catalog and see a grid of product listings
User can apply a manufacturer brand filter from the sidebar to narrow product results
User can click a product thumbnail to open its detail page and see the product name and price
User can browse the homepage and product listings without logging in as a guest
User can search for a product by name using the search bar and see relevant results
User can register a new account by filling in first name last name email telephone and password fields
User can log in with a registered email address and password and land on the account dashboard
User can log out from the account and be redirected to the home page
User can remove an item from the shopping cart and see the cart update with the item gone
User can update the quantity of an item in the shopping cart and see the line total recalculate
User can sort products by price low to high and see the listing order change
User can add a product to the wish list from the product detail page and view it in the wishlist
User can complete a guest checkout by entering a shipping address and selecting flat rate shipping

title: Top banner displays Memorial Day Sale
description: The application top banner should display a Memorial Day Sale banner
